1-UNITNING BESHINCHI BETI (10-bet). Oq fon.

Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq yorliqda oq '1' va yonida 'People around the World'; ostida gorizontal chiziq.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq ikki qatorli sarlavha: 'Grammar: Present Simple - Present Continuous'.
21) 'Name the tenses of the verbs in bold (1 - 5), then match them to their uses (a - e).' Chapda 1-5 gaplar (qalin harfli fe'llar bilan), o'ngda vertikal chiziq orqali a-e qo'llanishlar.
22) 'Make sentences about your country, using the present simple, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna: 'Most people in my country live in cities.'
23) 'Read Susan's letter on p. 9, underline all present continuous forms, then explain their uses.'
24) 'In pairs, use the prompts to ask and answer questions about each person, as in the example.' Ostida to'rtta surat va yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi yozuvlar:
  - jurnal o'qiyotgan sariq sochli ayol: 'Ann, England, married, secretary - types letters'
  - tennis o'ynayotgan yigit: 'Glen, Australia, single, mechanic - fixes cars'
  - gullar orasidagi qora tanli ayol: 'Marie, France, divorced, doctor - treats sick people'
  - daryoda baliq ovlayotgan erkak: 'Hans, Germany, married, lawyer - advises people about the law'
  Ostida ikki ustunli ko'k qiya namuna dialog.

O'NG USTUN:
25) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B. In pairs, ask each other questions. Then, write a short paragraph about your partner.' Ko'k qiya namuna: 'SA: How old are you? SB: I'm twelve years old.' Ostida och yashil ramkali ikki ustunli jadval (A va B).
26) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.' A va B o'rtasidagi dialog, 10 ta nuqtali joy va qavsda fe'llar.
27) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Choose the correct reply. Listen and check your answers, then act out the dialogues in pairs.' Oltita juftlik, har birida a va b variantlari.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game' sarlavhasi.
28) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya harfli so'zlar ro'yxati.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '10'.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Simple and Present Continuous - form and use.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Simple va Present Continuous - shakli va qo'llanishi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HOZIRGI ZAMON.


=== PRESENT SIMPLE ===

ShAKLI:
  I / you / we / they  + FE'L
  he / she / it        + FE'L + S

  I work.      He workS.
  We live.     She liveS.

INKOR:
  I don't work.   He doesn't work.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin -S TUShADI!
  'He doesn't workS' - XATO.

SO'ROQ:
  Do you work?   Does he work?

⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI:
  work  → works
  go    → goes   (o, s, sh, ch, x dan
  watch → watches   keyin -ES)
  study → studies (undosh + y → -IES)
  play  → plays   (unli + y → faqat -S)
  have  → has     (istisno)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  a) odat, kundalik ish
     'We spend our days hiking.'
  b) doimiy holat
     'Norwegians love the outdoors.'
  c) umumiy haqiqat
     'The sun rises in the east.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  always, usually, often, sometimes,
  never, every day, on Mondays


=== PRESENT CONTINUOUS ===

ShAKLI:
  am / is / are + FE'L + ING

  I am working.
  He is working.
  We are working.

INKOR:
  I'm not working.
  He isn't working.

SO'ROQ:
  Are you working?
  Is he working?

⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:
  work  → working
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → UNDOSh
                    IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  c) aynan hozir bo'layotgan ish
     'At the moment we are having a
      cup of hot chocolate.'
  e) shu davrda bo'layotgan ish
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
  d) yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja
     'Next week we're going to Oslo.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  now, at the moment, right now,
  today, this week, look!, listen!


=== ENG MUHIM FARQ ===

  'I work in a bank.'
     = mening kasbim shu (DOIMIY)

  'I'm working in a bank.'
     = hozircha shu yerda ishlayapman
       (VAQTINChA)


=== HOLAT FE'LLARI (state verbs) ===

  Bu fe'llar CONTINUOUS shaklda
  IShLATILMAYDI:

  like, love, hate, want, need,
  know, understand, believe,
  remember, forget, mean,
  belong, own, cost, seem

  ⚠ 'I am loving' - XATO.
     'I love' - to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Betdagi 26-mashqda: 'Mr Harris
  NEEDS me' - 'is needing' EMAS.


⚠ 'HAVE' - IKKI XIL:

  EGALIK ma'nosida - continuous YO'Q:
     'I have a car.' ('I am having a
      car' - XATO)

  IBORALARDA - continuous BOR:
     'We are having a cup of hot
      chocolate.'
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
     'We are having a meeting.'

  ⚠ Xatda ikkalasi ham uchraydi!

points.en: Present Simple: I work. / He works.
points.uz: Present Simple: Men ishlayman. / U ishlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda (he/she/it) fe'lga -S
qo'shiladi. Bu - eng ko'p unutiladigan qoida.

points.en: Present Simple negative: I don't work. / He doesn't work.
points.uz: Present Simple inkor: Men ishlamayman. / U ishlamaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda:
'He doesn't workS' - XATO.

⚠ -S allaqachon 'does' ichida.

points.en: Present Continuous: I am working. / He is working.
points.uz: Present Continuous: Men ishlayapman. / U ishlayapti.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to be' + fe'l + -ING.
⚠ 'to be' ni TUShIRIB QOLDIRMANG:
'I working' - XATO.

points.en: Present Simple is used for habits, routines and permanent states.
points.uz: Present Simple odat, kundalik tartib va doimiy holat uchun.
points.noteUz:
Belgi so'zlari: always, usually, often,
sometimes, never, every day.

points.en: Present Continuous is used for actions happening now or around now.
points.uz: Present Continuous hozir yoki shu davrda bo'layotgan ish uchun.
points.noteUz:
Belgi so'zlari: now, at the moment, today,
this week, Look!, Listen!

points.en: Present Continuous is also used for fixed arrangements in the near future.
points.uz: Present Continuous yaqin kelajakdagi aniq reja uchun ham ishlatiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Next week we're going to Oslo.'

⚠ Bu - chipta olingan, kelishilgan reja.
Shunchaki niyat bo'lsa 'be going to' ishlatiladi.

points.en: State verbs (like, love, know, need, want) are not used in the continuous.
points.uz: Holat fe'llari (like, love, know, need, want) continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I am knowing' - XATO. 'I know' - to'g'ri.

⚠ 26-mashqda: 'Mr Harris NEEDS me'.

points.en: 'have' takes the continuous only in expressions: have a meeting, have a good time.
points.uz: 'have' faqat iboralarda continuous oladi: yig'ilish o'tkazmoq, yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.
points.noteUz:
⚠ EGALIK: 'I have a car' (continuous YO'Q).
⚠ IBORA: 'We are having a meeting' (continuous BOR).

⚠ Syuzanning xatida ikkalasi ham bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Name the tenses of the verbs in bold (1 - 5), then match them to their uses (a - e).
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli fe'llarning zamonini ayting (1 - 5), so'ng ularni qo'llanishi bilan moslang (a - e).
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh GAP - BESh QO'LLANISh.

  Hamma gap 9-betdagi Syuzanning
  xatidan olingan.


QO'LLANIShLAR:

  a  habits/routines/repeated actions
     = odat, kundalik tartib, takroriy ish
     → PRESENT SIMPLE

  b  permanent states
     = doimiy holat
     → PRESENT SIMPLE

  c  actions happening at the time of
     speaking
     = AYNAN gapirayotgan paytdagi ish
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

  d  fixed arrangements in the near
     future
     = yaqin kelajakdagi aniq reja
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

  e  actions happening around the
     moment of speaking
     = shu davrda (aynan hozir emas)
       bo'layotgan ish
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS


⚠ 'c' va 'e' FARQI - JUDA MUHIM:

  c = AYNAN HOZIR, shu soniyada
     'At the moment we ARE HAVING a
      cup of hot chocolate.'
     (hozir stakan qo'lida)

  e = ShU DAVRDA, lekin aynan hozir
     emas
     'I'M HAVING a fantastic time.'
     (butun ta'til davomida; ayni
      soniyada uxlayotgan bo'lishi
      ham mumkin)

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham present continuous,
  lekin VAQT KENGLIGI boshqa.


⚠ 'a' va 'b' FARQI:

  a = HARAKAT, takrorlanadi
     'We SPEND our days hiking.'

  b = HOLAT, o'zgarmaydi
     'Norwegians LOVE the outdoors.'

  ⚠ 'love' - HOLAT fe'li, shuning uchun
  u continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

pairs.right: present continuous - e (actions happening around the moment of speaking)
pairs.rightUz: present continuous - e (gapirish davri atrofidagi ish)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Aynan shu soniyada emas - BUTUN TA'TIL
davomida.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'e', 'c' emas.

⚠ 'have a good time' - IBORA, shuning uchun
continuous mumkin.

pairs.left: 2  We spend our days hiking in the mountains.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Har kuni takrorlanadigan ish → PRESENT SIMPLE.

⚠ 'spend' - harakat fe'li, lekin bu yerda
ODAT bildirmoqda.

⚠ 'love' - HOLAT fe'li: continuous shaklda
ISHLATILMAYDI.

⚠ Bu o'zgarmaydigan xususiyat, odat emas -
shuning uchun 'b', 'a' emas.

pairs.left: 4  Next week we're going to Oslo.
pairs.right: present continuous - d (fixed arrangements in the near future)
pairs.rightUz: present continuous - d (yaqin kelajakdagi aniq reja)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'Next week' - KELASI vaqt, lekin fe'l
PRESENT CONTINUOUS shaklda!

⚠ Bu - ANIQ, kelishilgan reja (chipta olingan).
Shunchaki niyat bo'lsa 'be going to' bo'lardi.

pairs.left: 5  At the moment we are having a cup of hot chocolate.
pairs.right: present continuous - c (actions happening at the time of speaking)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'At the moment' - AYNAN HOZIR, shu soniyada.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'c', 'e' emas.

⚠ 'have a cup of' - IBORA, continuous mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences about your country, using the present simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Present simple bilan o'z mamlakatingiz haqida gap tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Most people in my country live in
   cities.'

  ⚠ 'live' - -S YO'Q, chunki ega
  'Most people' - KO'PLIK.


⚠ QOLIP:

  Most people in my country + FE'L + ...

  yoki

  In my country, people + FE'L + ...


⚠ NIMA HAQIDA YoZISh MUMKIN
(7-betdagi Tailand matni ro'yxati):

  • qayerda yashaydi
  • nima ish qiladi
  • nima yeydi
  • bo'sh vaqtida nima qiladi
  • qanday bayramlarni nishonlaydi
  • qanday ko'rinadi


⚠ 'MOST PEOPLE' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'Most people live in cities.' ✓
  'The most people live ...' ✗

  ⚠ 'the most' faqat qiyoslashda:
  'the most beautiful city'.
exercises.exampleEn: Most people in my country live in cities.
modelAnswers: Most people in my country eat bread with every meal.
People in my country celebrate Navruz in March.
Most families in my country live in houses, not flats.
People in my country drink a lot of green tea.
Most people in my country speak two or three languages.
In my country, people often invite guests to their homes.
modelAnswersUz: Mamlakatimdagi ko'pchilik har ovqat bilan non yeydi.
Mamlakatimdagi odamlar mart oyida Navro'zni nishonlaydi.
Mamlakatimdagi ko'p oilalar kvartirada emas, hovlida yashaydi.
Mamlakatimdagi odamlar ko'p ko'k choy ichadi.
Mamlakatimdagi ko'pchilik ikki yoki uch tilda gapiradi.
Mamlakatimda odamlar ko'pincha mehmonlarni uyiga taklif qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Susan's letter on p. 9, underline all present continuous forms, then explain their uses.
exercises.instructionUz: 9-betdagi Syuzanning xatini o'qing, barcha present continuous shakllarining tagiga chizing, so'ng ularning qo'llanishini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
XATDAGI HAMMA PRESENT CONTINUOUS
ShAKLI bandlarda berilgan.

  ⚠ Jami SAKKIZTA shakl bor.


⚠ QAYSI QO'LLANISh QAYSI GAPDA:

  ShU DAVRDA (e):
     I'm having a fantastic time
     we are staying at the Royal Hotel

  AYNAN HOZIR (c):
     we are having a cup of hot chocolate
     (and) enjoying the view

  YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI REJA (d):
     we're going to Oslo
     our flight is leaving next Friday

  ⚠ 'looking forward to it' - bu
  'I'M looking forward' ning qismi:
  hozirgi HISSIYoT (e).


⚠ DIQQAT - IKKI FE'L BITTA 'ARE' BILAN:

  'we are HAVING a cup of hot chocolate
   and ENJOYING the spectacular view'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi fe'ldan oldin 'are'
  TAKRORLANMAYDI - u tushirib
  qoldiriladi.

points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: e - shu davrda bo'layotgan ish
(butun ta'til davomida).

⚠ 'have a good time' - IBORA, shuning uchun
continuous mumkin.

points.en: Lee and I are staying at the historic Royal Hotel
points.uz: Li bilan men tarixiy Royal mehmonxonasida turibmiz
points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: e - VAQTINChA holat.

⚠ 'We stay at the Royal Hotel' desa - doimiy
yashaydi degani bo'lardi.

points.en: At the moment we are having a cup of hot chocolate
points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: c - AYNAN gapirish paytidagi ish.

⚠ 'At the moment' - bu qo'llanishning belgi
so'zi.

points.en: (we are) enjoying the spectacular view of the harbour
points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: c.

⚠ 'are' TAKRORLANMAYDI - bir yordamchi ikki
fe'lga xizmat qiladi.

Qo'llanish: e - hozirgi hissiyot.

⚠ 'look forward TO' - 'to' predlog, keyin
OT yoki -ING.

points.en: Next week we're going to Oslo
points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: d - yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja.

⚠ Fe'l hozirgi zamonda, ma'no KELASI zamonda.

points.en: Our flight is leaving from Oslo next Friday
points.uz: Reysimiz kelasi juma kuni Oslodan jo'naydi
points.noteUz:
Qo'llanish: d - jadval bo'yicha belgilangan
reja.

⚠ Transport uchun present simple ham mumkin:
'Our flight leaves next Friday'.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to ask and answer questions about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib har bir odam haqida savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA ODAM:

  Ann, England, married, secretary -
     types letters
  Glen, Australia, single, mechanic -
     fixes cars
  Marie, France, divorced, doctor -
     treats sick people
  Hans, Germany, married, lawyer -
     advises people about the law


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Where does Ann live?
  SB: She lives in England.
  SA: Is she married?
  SB: Yes, she is.
  SA: What does she do?
  SB: She's a secretary.
  SA: What does she do at work?
  SB: She types letters.
  SA: What is she doing now?
  SB: She's reading a magazine.


⚠ ENG MUHIM JOYI - OXIRGI IKKI SAVOL:

  'What does she DO?'
     = kasbi nima? (PRESENT SIMPLE)
     → 'She's a secretary.'

  'What is she DOING now?'
     = hozir nima qilyapti?
       (PRESENT CONTINUOUS)
     → 'She's reading a magazine.'

  ⚠ Bir xil fe'l 'do', lekin IKKI XIL
  zamon - IKKI XIL ma'no. Butun
  mashqning maqsadi shu.


⚠ OILAVIY HOLAT:

  single   - turmush qurmagan
  married  - turmush qurgan
  divorced - ajrashgan
  widowed  - beva


⚠ KASB VA UNING IShI:

  a secretary - types letters
  a mechanic  - fixes cars
  a doctor    - treats sick people
  a lawyer    - advises people about
                the law

items.question: Where does Ann live?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ Savolda 'does' bor, shuning uchun 'live'
ODDIY shaklda. Javobda esa 'liveS'.

items.question: Is she married?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ 'married' - SIFAT, shuning uchun 'to be' bilan.

items.question: What does she do?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'What do you DO?' = kasbingiz nima?
Bu - turg'un savol.

items.question: What does she do at work?
What is she doing now?
items.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - 'now' belgi so'zi.

⚠ 3 va 5-savolni SOLIShTIRING: bir xil fe'l,
ikki xil zamon, ikki xil ma'no.

items.prompt: Glenning kasbi nima va ishda nima qiladi?
items.question: What does Glen do at work?
items.answer: He's a mechanic. He fixes cars.

items.prompt: Mari qayerda yashaydi va oilaviy holati qanday?
items.question: Where does Marie live? Is she married?
items.answer: She lives in France. No, she isn't. She's divorced.

items.question: What does Marie do at work?
items.answer: She's a doctor. She treats sick people.

items.prompt: Hans qayerda yashaydi va oilaviy holati qanday?
items.question: Where does Hans live? Is he married?
items.answer: He lives in Germany. Yes, he is.

items.question: What does Hans do at work?
items.answer: He's a lawyer. He advises people about the law.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in column A to those in column B. In pairs, ask each other questions. Then, write a short paragraph about your partner.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunidagi bandlarni B ustunidagilarga moslang. Juftlikda bir-biringizga savol bering. So'ng sherigingiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLNI IKKI BO'LAKDAN YIG'ISh.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: How old are you?
  SB: I'm twelve years old.


TO'LIQ SAVOLLAR:

  How old are you?
     = necha yoshdasiz?

  How tall are you?
     = bo'yingiz qancha?

  What type of build are you?
     = gavdangiz qanday?

  What colour eyes have you got?
     = ko'zingiz qanday rangda?

  What is your hair like?
     = sochingiz qanday?

  Have you got glasses/a beard/
  freckles, etc?
     = ko'zoynagingiz/soqolingiz/
       sepkilingiz bormi?


⚠ 'HOW OLD ARE YOU?' - 'TO BE' BILAN:

  ⚠ O'zbekchada 'yoshim bor' deymiz,
  inglizchada esa 'I AM twelve'.
  'I have twelve years' - XATO.


⚠ 'WHAT COLOUR EYES HAVE YOU GOT?'

  So'z tartibi g'alati ko'rinadi, lekin
  to'g'ri: 'What colour' + OT + savol.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday:
     'What size shoes do you wear?'
     'What kind of music do you like?'


⚠ 'WHAT IS YOUR HAIR LIKE?'

  ⚠ 'like' bu yerda 'qanday' ma'nosida.
  Javob: 'It's long and curly.'

  ⚠ 'What does your hair look like?'
  ham to'g'ri.


⚠ JAVOB NAMUNALARI:

  How old are you?
     I'm twelve years old.
  How tall are you?
     I'm 1 metre 50.
  What type of build are you?
     I'm slim. / I'm of medium build.
  What colour eyes have you got?
     I've got brown eyes.
  What is your hair like?
     It's short and dark.
  Have you got glasses?
     Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

pairs.whyUz:
To'liq savol: 'How old are you?'

⚠ Javob 'to be' bilan: 'I'm twelve years old.'
'I have twelve years' - XATO.

To'liq savol: 'How tall are you?'

⚠ Javob: 'I'm 1 metre 60' yoki futda:
'I'm five foot six'.

To'liq savol: 'What type of build are you?'

⚠ 'build' = gavda tuzilishi (8-betdagi jadval).
Javob: 'I'm slim' / 'I'm of medium build'.

To'liq savol: 'What colour eyes have you got?'

⚠ 'What colour' + OT - g'alati ko'rinadi, lekin
to'g'ri qolip.

To'liq savol: 'What is your hair like?'

⚠ 'like' bu yerda 'qanday' ma'nosida.
Javob: 'It's short and dark.'

To'liq savol: 'Have you got glasses?'

⚠ 'glasses' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ Qisqa javob: 'Yes, I have.' / 'No, I haven't.'

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IDORADAGI TANIShUV DIALOGI.

  Toni Miller Mister Xarrisni qidiryapti;
  Syuzan Bler - Mister Xarrisning kotibi.


⚠ HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  am looking for - AYNAN HOZIR
     qidiryapti (continuous)
  2  am going - yaqin kelajakdagi
     REJA (continuous)
  3  Do you work - DOIMIY ish
     (simple)
  4  work - doimiy ish (simple)
  5  am - holat (simple)
  6  Are you doing - kelajakdagi
     reja (continuous)
  7  leave - ODAT ('usually' belgisi!)
     (simple)
  8  am staying - BUGUN, vaqtinchalik
     ('today' belgisi!) (continuous)
  9  are having - 'have a meeting'
     iborasi, bugungi reja (continuous)
  10 needs - HOLAT fe'li, continuous
     BO'LMAYDI (simple)


⚠ ENG MUHIM UCh JOY:

  7 va 8 QARAMA-QARShI QO'YILGAN:
     'I USUALLY leave work at four,
      BUT TODAY I'm staying late'
     usually → simple
     today   → continuous

  10-band TUZOQ:
     'need' - HOLAT fe'li.
     'Mr Harris IS NEEDING me' - XATO.
     'Mr Harris NEEDS me' - to'g'ri.


⚠ 'MR HARRIS'' - EGALIK:

  's' bilan tugaydigan ismga egalik
  qo'shilsa faqat APOSTROF qo'yiladi:
     Mr Harris' secretary
  ⚠ 'Mr Harris's' ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi.


⚠ 'EXCUSE ME' va 'SORRY':

  'Excuse me' - GAP BOShLAShDAN oldin
     (e'tibor tortish uchun)
  'Sorry' - XATO qilgandan KEYIN

  ⚠ Dialogda ikkalasi ham bor!


⚠ 'NICE TO MEET YOU':

  Birinchi marta tanishganda.
  Javob: 'Nice to meet you, too.'

  ⚠ Keyingi uchrashuvlarda
  'Nice to SEE you' deyiladi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me. I 1) ___ (look for) Mr Harris.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ AYNAN HOZIR bo'layotgan ish → CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to look FOR' = qidirmoq (predlog 'for').

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: U yuqori qavatda. Men ham o'sha yerga ketyapman.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Yaqin kelajakdagi reja → CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'myself' = o'zim ham.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh really? Can I come with you?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu qatorda bo'shliq yo'q.
⚠ 'Can I ...?' - ruxsat so'rash.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ DOIMIY ish haqida savol → SIMPLE.
⚠ So'roqda 'Do' + ega + fe'l (oddiy shaklda).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes. I 4) ___ (work) in the Sales Department. How about you?
lines.uz: Ha. Men Savdo bo'limida ishlayman. Sizchi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ DOIMIY ish → SIMPLE.
⚠ 'I' bilan -S YO'Q.
⚠ 'How about you?' = sizchi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I 5) ___ (be) Mr Harris' secretary, Susan Blair.
lines.uz: Men janob Xarrisning kotibi, Syuzan Blermon.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ HOLAT → SIMPLE.
⚠ "Mr Harris'" - 's' bilan tugagan ismga
egalik: faqat APOSTROF.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Tony Miller. Nice to meet you.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu qatorda bo'shliq yo'q.
⚠ Birinchi tanishuvda 'Nice to MEET you'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: 6) ___ (you/do) anything later? We could go for a coffee after work.
lines.uz: Keyinroq biror ish qilasizmi? Ishdan keyin qahvaga borsak bo'lardi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Yaqin kelajakdagi REJA haqida savol →
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'could' - taklifni YUMShATADI.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I usually 7) ___ (leave) work at four, but today I 8) ___ (stay) late because we 9) ___ (have) an important meeting and Mr Harris 10) ___ (need) me. Sorry - some other time, perhaps.
lines.uz: Men odatda ishdan soatda to'rtda chiqaman, lekin bugun kech qolaman, chunki muhim yig'ilishimiz bor va janob Xarrisga kerakman. Kechirasiz - boshqa safar, balki.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 7: 'usually' → ODAT → SIMPLE.
⚠ 8: 'today' → BUGUNGI vaqtinchalik ish →
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 9: 'have a meeting' - IBORA, bugungi reja →
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 10: 'need' - HOLAT fe'li, continuous
BO'LMAYDI → SIMPLE, 3-shaxs birlik: 'needS'.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct reply. Listen and check your answers, then act out the dialogues in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri javobni tanlang. Tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring, so'ng juftlikda dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUNDALIK MULOQOT QOLIPLARI.

  ⚠ Bu javoblarni MANTIQ bilan topish
  mumkin - audio faqat tekshirish uchun.


⚠ SALOMLAShUV JUFTLIKLARI:

  Hello! / Hi!      → Hi! / Hello!
  How are you?      → Fine, thanks.
  Goodbye!          → See you later!
  Good night!       → Sleep well!

  ⚠ 'How are you?' - HAQIQIY savol emas,
  shunchaki salomlashuv. Javob doim
  qisqa va ijobiy.


⚠ MINNATDORChILIK:

  Here you are.     → Thanks very much.
     ('Here you are' = mana, oling)

  ⚠ 'Here you are' ham 'Here you go' ham
  bir xil ma'noda.


⚠ UZR SO'RASh:

  I'm sorry!        → That's okay.

  ⚠ Boshqa javoblar: 'Never mind',
  'Don't worry about it', 'It's all right'.


⚠ 'GOOD NIGHT' - SALOMLAShUV EMAS:

  'Good morning/afternoon/evening' -
     uchrashganda
  'Good night' - FAQAT XAYRLAShGANDA
     (kechqurun tarqalayotganda)

  ⚠ Shuning uchun javobi 'How are you?'
  bo'lolmaydi - 'Sleep well!'

items.whyUz:
⚠ Salomga SALOM bilan javob beriladi.

⚠ 'Fine, thanks' - 'How are you?' ga javob.

⚠ "That's okay" - uzr so'raganga javob.

⚠ 'How are you?' ga: 'Fine, thanks',
'Very well, thank you', 'Not bad'.

⚠ 'Sleep well' faqat KEChASI, uxlashga
borayotganda.

⚠ 'See you later!' - istalgan vaqtda.

⚠ 'Here you are' = mana, oling.

⚠ Javob - MINNATDORChILIK.

⚠ Uzrga 'Thank you' deyilmaydi.

⚠ Yana: 'Never mind', 'Don't worry'.

⚠ 'Goodnight' - SALOMLAShUV EMAS, faqat
XAYRLAShUV.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'How are you?' mos kelmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Guruhlarga bo'linib, quyidagi so'z va iboralar bilan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNITNING BUTUN LUG'ATI - BITTA
O'YINDA.

  ⚠ 17 ta so'z/ibora. Hammasi
  6-10-betlarda uchragan.

  ⚠ O'yin qoidasi: guruhlar navbat bilan
  gap tuzadi, har to'g'ri gap - 1 ochko.


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU USUL IShLAYDI:

  So'zni ALOHIDA yodlash oson unutiladi.
  So'z bilan GAP TUZGANDA u xotirada
  kontekst bilan bog'lanadi va mustahkam
  qoladi.

  ⚠ Bu 'generation effect' deb ataladi:
  o'zi HOSIL QILGAN gap o'qilgan gapdan
  ancha yaxshi esda qoladi.


⚠ QIYIN IBORALARGA DIQQAT:

  'well known for' + OT/-ING
  'proud of' + OT/-ING
  'look forward to' + OT/-ING
  'tend to be' + SIFAT

  ⚠ Uchtasida ham 'to'/'for'/'of' -
  PREDLOG, shuning uchun keyin -ING
  keladi, oddiy fe'l emas.

modelSentences.sentence: My uncle is a bit overweight, but he is very strong.
modelSentences.uz: Amakimning vazni biroz ortiqcha, lekin u juda kuchli.

modelSentences.sentence: She has got a friendly smile.
Italy is well known for its pizza.
My neighbour is very mean; he never spends money.
modelSentences.uz: Qo'shnim juda xasis; u hech qachon pul sarflamaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: My grandmother has got a few wrinkles.
What does your brother look like?
In my free time I play football with my friends.
modelSentences.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman.

modelSentences.sentence: We celebrate Navruz on the twenty-first of March.
modelSentences.uz: Biz Navro'zni yigirma birinchi martda nishonlaymiz.

modelSentences.sentence: The view from the mountain is stunning.
I am very proud of my sister.
In spring the farmers plant the crops.
My best friend is very sociable; she talks to everybody.
modelSentences.uz: Eng yaqin do'stim juda kirishimli; u hamma bilan gaplashadi.

modelSentences.sentence: The girl in the picture has got full lips.
My father really loves the outdoors.
We spend most of our holidays hiking in the mountains.
modelSentences.uz: Ta'tilimizning ko'pini tog'da piyoda yurib o'tkazamiz.

modelSentences.sentence: I am looking forward to seeing you next week.
modelSentences.uz: Keyingi hafta sizni ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.

patterns.formula: What does he/she do? - He's/She's a [kasb].
patterns.exampleEn: What does she do? - She's a secretary.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - DOIMIY kasb.
⚠ 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?

patterns.formula: What is he/she doing now? - He's/She's [fe'l]-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: What is she doing now? - She's reading a magazine.
patterns.exampleUz: U hozir nima qilyapti? - U jurnal o'qiyapti.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - HOZIRGI ish.
⚠ Oldingi qolip bilan SOLIShTIRING: bir xil fe'l
'do', ikki xil zamon, ikki xil ma'no.

patterns.formula: I usually [fe'l], but today I am [fe'l]-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: I usually leave work at four, but today I'm staying late.
patterns.exampleUz: Odatda ishdan to'rtda chiqaman, lekin bugun kech qolaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'usually' → SIMPLE; 'today' → CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ikki zamonni bitta gapda qarshilantiruvchi
eng foydali qolip.

patterns.formula: How old are you? - I'm [son] years old.
patterns.exampleEn: How old are you? - I'm twelve years old.
patterns.exampleUz: Necha yoshdasiz? - Men o'n ikki yoshdaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Yosh 'to be' bilan aytiladi.
⚠ 'I have twelve years' - XATO.

patterns.formula: What colour eyes have you got? - I've got [rang] eyes.
patterns.exampleEn: What colour eyes have you got? - I've got brown eyes.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'What colour' + OT + savol - turg'un qolip.
⚠ 'eyes' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

wordFormation.introUz: Kasb nomlari va ular bilan bog'liq so'zlar.

groups.explanationUz: Britaniya inglizchasida fe'lda 'S', otda 'C'. 24-mashqdagi 'advise' shu qoidadan.
24-mashqdagi to'rt kasb va ular bajaradigan ish.
Present simple da he/she/it bilan fe'l qanday o'zgaradi.

items.note: ⚠ betda shu; x, s, sh, ch, o dan keyin -ES
